summary: Iteration 3 testing of multi-provider Co-Pilot (gemini, openai, anthropic, azure_openai, m365_copilot, gemma). Backend: 21/21 iter3 tests + 15/15 iter2 + 26/26 iter1 = 62/62 PASS (100%) in 61s, real Gemini call verified, Azure/M365/Gemma error paths return graceful 200 string replies (not 5xx). Frontend: Settings page provider dropdown shows all 6 providers; dynamic blocks (copilot-emergent-config / copilot-azure-config / copilot-m365-config / copilot-gemma-config) toggle correctly with only the relevant block visible; saving credentials triggers a 'Settings saved' toast; after reload secrets are masked as ***LAST4 while non-secret fields are preserved. Regression smoke (Dashboard, Documents list, Document Viewer, Audit Logs with new update_ocr_settings + copilot_provider entries) all render fine.

issues: Recharts width(-1)/height(-1) warning persists from iter1/iter2 (cosmetic, not blocking).

action_items: (None blocking) Optional: split server.py (now 1363 lines) into auth.py / documents.py / ocr_engines.py / copilot.py / exports.py — exceeds 700-line guideline.
(LOW) Recharts width(-1)/height(-1) chart container warnings on Dashboard persist — wrap chart in a sized parent with minWidth/minHeight.
critical_code_review_comments: PUT /tenants/me/ocr-settings now uses payload.model_dump(exclude_unset=True) — partial updates correctly preserve all unsent fields (verified by setting all credentials then sending {gemma_model: 'x'} and confirming everything else stays).

SECRET_FIELDS = ['olmocr_api_key','azure_api_key','m365_client_secret','gemma_api_key'] are all masked on GET as ***LAST4 and silently ignored on PUT when starting with ***. Verified plaintext does NOT leak in any response. Strong security pattern.

copilot_provider validation: rejects unknown values with 400 ('must be one of: gemini, openai, anthropic, azure_openai, m365_copilot, gemma') and mirrors to legacy copilot_model_provider for back-compat.

copilot_reply routes correctly to _copilot_emergent / _copilot_azure_openai / _copilot_m365 / _copilot_gemma based on provider. All branches return strings (never raise) — outer try/except adds a defensive 'Co-Pilot error: {e}' net.

Azure OpenAI handler: tries httpx call, catches HTTPStatusError -> 'Azure OpenAI error {code}' and generic Exception -> 'Azure OpenAI request failed: {e}'. Verified with fake host -> graceful 200 reply.

M365 Copilot handler: _m365_get_token uses MongoDB token cache (db.token_cache) with 2-min skew, falls through with None on failure; _copilot_m365 returns 'Microsoft 365 Copilot is not fully configured...' or '...failed (status)...' string. Verified does not crash with fake creds.
Gemma handler: hits OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions on configured endpoint, returns 'Gemma request failed: {e}' or 'Gemma error {code}' on failure. Verified.
Audit log records update_ocr_settings action with details.copilot_provider — verified via /api/audit-logs GET and visually in UI.
RBAC: non-admin (operations user) PUT /tenants/me/ocr-settings returns 403 — confirmed.

Frontend Settings: all 9 new data-testids exist (copilot-provider-select, copilot-emergent-config, copilot-azure-config + azure-endpoint/deployment/apikey/api-version-input, copilot-m365-config + m365-tenant/client/secret/scope-input, copilot-gemma-config + gemma-endpoint/model/apikey/timeout-input). Provider switch shows ONLY the matching block.
server.py is 1363 lines (was 1138 in iter2) — past 700-line guideline. Recommend module split. Not blocking.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Three backend test files now: backend_test.py (iter1, 26 tests), test_iteration2.py (iter2, 15 tests), test_iteration3.py (iter3, 21 tests). Run all together: `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v` (~60s, real Gemini call ~30s). Real LLM calls (gemini/openai/anthropic via Emergent key) take ~10-30s each; azure_openai/m365_copilot/gemma error-path tests are fast (~5s) because they hit nonexistent hosts. Tenant ocr_settings are reset to DEFAULTS at module end. The Microsoft 365 Copilot beta /copilot/conversations endpoint requires delegated permissions and admin consent — our code path handles this with a graceful string reply, do not treat 4xx responses from MS Graph as a bug. All 9 new Settings data-testids documented in iter3 problem statement are present and verified.
rca of the issue: No bugs found in iter3 — the partial-PUT fix (model_dump(exclude_unset=True)), masking of all 4 secret fields, 6-provider routing, validation, RBAC, and audit log are all working end-to-end. Iter2's DocumentUpload engineOverride fix is preserved.
